clos.original_description: Understand what is data mining and what are key components of the data mining pipeline
clos.enriched_description: Understand what is data mining and what are key components of the data mining pipeline. The scope includes Introduction to Data mining Pipeline, Data understanding, Data understadining, and Data Warehouse Architecture.

clos.original_description: Learn and apply one of the basic core of data mining: data visualization
clos.enriched_description: Learn and apply one of the basic core of data mining: data visualization. The scope includes Data visualization, Introduction of data visualization, Visualization of Numerical Data, Visualization of Non-Numerical Data, and The Visualization of Dashboard.

clos.original_description: Understand and apply one subtield in data mining: patern discovery, practice with the data visualization of data mining
clos.enriched_description: Understand and apply one subfield in data mining: pattern discovery, practice with the data visualization of data mining. The scope includes Pattern Discovery in Data mining, Introduction to Pattern Discovery 1, What Is Pattern Discovery? Why Is It Important?, Introduction to Pattern Discovery 2 3.1.3 Compressed Representation: Closed Patterns and Max-Patterns, Mining Frequent Patterns by Exploring Vertical Data Format, Mining Closed Patterns, Mining Compressed Patterns, Mining sequential patterns 3.9.1. Sequential Pattern and Sequential Pattern Mining, GSP: Apriori-Based Sequential Pattern Mining, Mining sequential patterns 2 3.9.3. SPADE-Sequential Pattern Mining in Vertical Data Format, Advanced topics on pattern discovery 1 3.12.1. Frequent Pattern Mining in Data Streams 3.12.2. Pattern, and Advanced Topics on Pattern Discovery 2 3.12.4 Pattern Mining and Society-Privacy Issue 3.12.5. Looking Forward.

clos.original_description: Apply another subtield in data mining: cluster analysis
clos.enriched_description: Apply another subfield in data mining: cluster analysis. The scope includes Cluster Analysis in Data mining, Introduction to Cluster Analysis 1 4.1.1. What is Cluster Analysis 4.1.2. Applications of Cluster Analysis, Introduction to Cluster Analysis 2 4.1.4 A Multi-Dimensional Categorization 4.1.5 An Overview of Typical, Similarity Measures for Cluster Analysis 1 4.2.1 Basic Concepts: Measuring Similarity between Objects, Distance on Numeric Data Minkowski Distance, Similarity Measures for Cluster Analysis 2, Partitioning-Based Clustering Methods 1, Partitioning-Based Clustering Methods, Agglomerative Clustering Algorithms, Divisive Clustering Algorithms, DBSCAN: A Density-Based Clustering Algorithm, and Clustering Evaluation Measuring Clustering Quality.
